## Package

- Name: @thenamespace/ens-components
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@thenamespace/ens-components
- GitHub: https://github.com/thenamespace/ens-components
- License: MIT
- Namespace app: https://app.namespace.ninja (offchain API keys at /offchain, ENSv2 activations for onchain subnames)

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install @thenamespace/ens-components wagmi viem @tanstack/react-query
```

Import the stylesheet once at your app root:

```tsx
import "@thenamespace/ens-components/styles";
```

---

## Quick Start

```tsx
// providers.tsx (or equivalent app root)
import { WagmiProvider, createConfig, http } from "wagmi";
import { mainnet } from "wagmi/chains";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";

const config = createConfig({
  chains: [mainnet],
  transports: { [mainnet.id]: http() },
});
const queryClient = new QueryClient();

export function Providers({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <WagmiProvider config={config}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        {children}
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </WagmiProvider>
  );
}

// page.tsx
import "@thenamespace/ens-components/styles";
import { EnsNameRegistrationForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

export default function Page() {
  return <EnsNameRegistrationForm />;
}
```

---

## Framework Compatibility

| Framework         | Support | Notes |
|-------------------|---------|-------|
| Next.js App Router | ✅ | Mark component tree as `"use client"` or use `next/dynamic` with `ssr: false` |
| Next.js Pages Router | ✅ | Import normally; works with `_app.tsx` providers |
| Remix             | ✅ | Use `<ClientOnly>` wrapper or `lazy` imports for SSR safety |
| Vite + React      | ✅ | No special setup needed |
| Create React App  | ✅ | No special setup needed |

Components use wagmi hooks (window.ethereum, wallet state) and must render on the client.

`OffchainSubnameForm` supports DNS names already imported into ENS, such as `example.com`,
as do old Namespace listings minted with `SubnameMintForm version={1}`. Registration and
renewal only handle second-level `.eth` names and do not perform DNS imports.

---

## ENSv2

Registration, renewal, records, and onchain subnames run on ENSv2 by default (since 3.0), on
mainnet and on Sepolia (`isTestnet`). The one ENSv1 flow still in use is minting under an old
Namespace listing: pass `version={1}` to `SubnameMintForm` for those parents. Old listings may
be DNS names imported into ENS; ENSv2 parents are `.eth` names.

- Registration and `.eth` renewal are paid in USDC or DAI. Each owner gets one PermissionedResolver,
  deployed with their first registration.
- Subname mints are paid in ETH, USDC, or DAI on mainnet; ETH or USDC on Sepolia.
- Wallets with EIP-5792 atomic batching sign the token approval, resolver deployment, and main
  transaction in one request. Other wallets send them one at a time.
- If the wallet holds too little of the payment token or too little ETH for gas, the form
  shows "Insufficient funds" and blocks the transaction.

---

## Component Reference

---

### EnsNameRegistrationForm

Full .eth name registration flow: search → commit → 60-second wait → register.
Requires the connected wallet to be on mainnet (or Sepolia if isTestnet=true).

```tsx
import { EnsNameRegistrationForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

<EnsNameRegistrationForm
  name="alice"
  onRegistrationSuccess={(result) => console.log("Registered!", result)}
/>
```

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| name | `string` | `undefined` | Pre-fill the search input with this name (label only or full "label.eth") |
| isTestnet | `boolean` | `false` | Use Sepolia testnet ENS contracts |
| version | `1 \| 2` | `2` | Leave unset. ENSv1 registration is retired |
| referrer | `Address` | Namespace's referrer | Referrer address recorded with the registration |
| noBorder | `boolean` | `false` | Remove the card border/shadow |
| className | `string` | `undefined` | Additional CSS class on the root element |
| title | `string` | `undefined` | Override the card title |
| subtitle | `string` | `undefined` | Override the card subtitle |
| bannerImage | `string` | `undefined` | URL of a custom banner image |
| hideBanner | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the top decorative banner |
| bannerWidth | `number` | `undefined` | Width in px of the banner image |
| avatarUploadDomain | `string` | `undefined` | SIWE domain for avatar/header image uploads |
| onRegistrationSuccess | `(result: RegistrationSuccessData) => void` | `undefined` | Called after successful registration |
| onRegistrationStart | `(name: string) => void` | `undefined` | Called when the user starts the commit step |
| onConnectWallet | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called when the connect-wallet button is clicked |
| onClose | `(isSuccess: boolean) => void` | `undefined` | Called when the user closes/dismisses the form |

#### Callback Types

```ts
interface RegistrationSuccessData {
  durationLabel: string;      // human-readable duration e.g. "1 year" or "6 months, 3 days"
  registrationCost: string;   // the USDC or DAI amount
  transactionFees: string;    // formatted ETH string
  total: string;              // formatted ETH string; network fees only
  expiryDate: string;         // formatted date string e.g. "April 28, 2027"
}
```

> **Breaking change (v1.3.0):** `expiryInYears: number` was removed. Use `durationLabel: string` instead.

#### Duration Picker

The form includes a built-in registration duration picker. Default mode shows a `− N year(s) +`
control. Users can toggle to a calendar date picker to choose an exact expiry date. Minimum
registration is **28 days** — enforced by the ENS `ETHRegistrarController` contract.

#### Behavior Without Wallet

If no wallet is connected, the form shows a "Connect Wallet" prompt. The user can still type a
name and see availability, but the commit/register buttons are disabled. Pass `onConnectWallet`
to hook into your own wallet connection modal.

---

### EnsRecordsForm

Profile record editor for an ENS name. Takes the current records as a prop, renders the editor,
and submits one transaction with the changed records. It detects the resolver type (standard
resolver, ENSv2 PermissionedResolver, or Namespace SimplifiedResolver) and encodes the
setters to match.

```tsx
import { EnsRecordsForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

// existingRecords must be fetched externally (e.g. via viem or your own resolver query)
// and passed in. EnsRecordsForm does not fetch records itself.
const existingRecords = { addresses: [], texts: [] }; // replace with your fetched records

<EnsRecordsForm
  name="alice.eth"
  existingRecords={existingRecords}
  onRecordsUpdated={(diff) => console.log("Updated", diff)}
/>
```

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| name | `string` | **required** | Full ENS name (e.g. "alice.eth") |
| existingRecords | `EnsRecords` | **required** | Current records to populate the editor |
| isTestnet | `boolean` | `false` | Use Sepolia |
| version | `1 \| 2` | `2` | Leave unset. Finds the resolver through the ENSv2 Universal Resolver |
| resolverChainId | `number` | `undefined` | Override which chain to resolve on |
| resolverAddress | `Address` | `undefined` | Override the resolver contract address |
| noBorder | `boolean` | `false` | Remove card border |
| className | `string` | `undefined` | Additional CSS class |
| avatarUploadDomain | `string` | `undefined` | SIWE domain for avatar/header image uploads |
| txConfirmations | `number` | `1` | Number of block confirmations to wait for |
| onRecordsUpdated | `(diff: EnsRecordsDiff) => void` | `undefined` | Called after confirmed update |
| onTransactionSent | `(hash: Hash) => void` | `undefined` | Called immediately after tx broadcast |
| onCancel | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called when the user cancels |
| onGreat | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called when the user clicks "Great" on the success screen |

#### Behavior Without Wallet

If no wallet is connected or the wallet is on the wrong chain, the form shows a
"Connect & Switch Chain" prompt instead of the save button. The editor UI is still rendered so
users can inspect records.

---

### SelectRecordsForm

Standalone record selector with no wallet requirement. Renders the same editor UI as
EnsRecordsForm but calls back with an updated EnsRecords object on every change. You control
what happens with the data (e.g. display a custom submit button, batch it with other operations).

```tsx
import { SelectRecordsForm, EnsRecords } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

const [records, setRecords] = useState<EnsRecords>({ addresses: [], texts: [] });

<SelectRecordsForm
  records={records}
  onRecordsUpdated={setRecords}
  actionButtons={<button onClick={handleSave}>Save</button>}
/>
```

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| records | `EnsRecords` | **required** | Current record state to display |
| onRecordsUpdated | `(records: EnsRecords) => void` | **required** | Called with updated records on every change |
| actionButtons | `React.ReactNode` | `undefined` | Custom buttons rendered below the form |
| avatarUpload | `AvatarUploadContext` | `undefined` | Enable avatar/header image upload UI |
| noBorder | `boolean` | `false` | Remove card border |

```ts
interface AvatarUploadContext {
  ensName: string;
  isTestnet?: boolean;
  siweDomain?: string;  // domain used for SIWE message
}
```

---

### OffchainSubnameForm

Gasless offchain subname creation via the Namespace CCIP-Read gateway (EIP-3668).
Subnames are created instantly without any wallet transaction for the end user.
Requires a `OffchainClient` instance from `@thenamespace/offchain-manager`.

```tsx
import { OffchainSubnameForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";
import { createOffchainClient } from "@thenamespace/offchain-manager";

const client = createOffchainClient({
  domainApiKeys: { "myname.eth": "YOUR_API_KEY" },
  mode: "mainnet", // or "sepolia"
});

<OffchainSubnameForm
  offchainManager={client}
  name="myname.eth"
  onSubnameCreated={(data) => console.log("Created", data.fullSubname)}
/>
```

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| offchainManager | `OffchainClient` | **required** | Client instance from @thenamespace/offchain-manager |
| name | `string` | **required** | Parent ENS name, including an ENS-imported DNS name (e.g. "myname.eth" or "example.com") |
| label | `string` | `undefined` | Pre-fill the subname label input |
| isTestnet | `boolean` | `false` | Use Sepolia |
| title | `string` | `undefined` | Override card title |
| subtitle | `string` | `undefined` | Override card subtitle |
| hideTitle | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the title/subtitle section |
| noBorder | `boolean` | `false` | Remove card border |
| avatarUploadDomain | `string` | `undefined` | SIWE domain for avatar/header uploads |
| onSubnameCreated | `(data: OffchainSubnameCreatedData) => void \| Promise<void>` | `undefined` | Called after successful creation |
| onSubnameUpdated | `(data: OffchainSubnameCreatedData) => void \| Promise<void>` | `undefined` | Called after successful update |
| onCancel | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called on cancel |

#### Callback Types

```ts
interface OffchainSubnameCreatedData {
  label: string;         // subname label (e.g. "alice")
  parentName: string;    // parent name (e.g. "myname.eth")
  fullSubname: string;   // full name (e.g. "alice.myname.eth")
  addresses: Array<{ chain: ChainName; value: string }>;
  texts: Array<{ key: string; value: string }>;
  owner?: string;        // owner address if set
}
```

#### Getting an API Key

Connect your wallet on https://app.namespace.ninja/offchain and generate an API key for your
ENS name.

#### Behavior Without Wallet

OffchainSubnameForm does not require a connected wallet. The subname is created server-side via
the Namespace API. A wallet is only needed if the form is configured to set an owner address.

---

### SubnameMintForm

Onchain subname minting under a Namespace-activated ENS name. Looks up the mint price for the
parent name, lets the user choose a label and set records, then submits a wallet transaction.
The user picks the payment token. Pass `version={1}` for a parent on an old Namespace
listing.

```tsx
import { SubnameMintForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

<SubnameMintForm
  parentName="myname.eth"
  onSubnameMinted={(data) => console.log("Minted", data.fullSubname)}
/>
```

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| parentName | `string` | **required** | Activated `.eth` parent to mint under. Old listings (`version={1}`) may also be ENS-imported DNS names |
| label | `string` | `undefined` | Pre-fill the subname label |
| isTestnet | `boolean` | `false` | Use Sepolia |
| version | `1 \| 2` | `2` | `1` mints under an old Namespace listing |
| resolver | `Address` | Namespace shared resolver | ENSv2 only. Resolver for the new subname when the parent's activation doesn't pin one |
| title | `string` | `undefined` | Override card title |
| subtitle | `string` | `undefined` | Override card subtitle |
| noBorder | `boolean` | `false` | Remove card border |
| avatarUploadDomain | `string` | `undefined` | SIWE domain for avatar/header uploads |
| txConfirmations | `number` | `1` | Block confirmations to wait for |
| onSubnameMinted | `(data: SubnameMintedData) => void` | `undefined` | Called after confirmed mint |
| onSuccess | `(data: MintSuccessData) => void` | `undefined` | Alternative success callback |
| onConnectWallet | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called when connect-wallet button is clicked |
| onCancel | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called on cancel |

#### Callback Types

```ts
interface SubnameMintedData {
  label: string;
  parentName: string;
  fullSubname: string;
  records: EnsRecords;
  price: string;           // formatted ETH string
  transactionFees: string; // formatted ETH string
  ownerAddress: string;
  txHash: string;
  chainId: number;
}

interface MintSuccessData {
  fullName: string;
  label: string;
  parentName: string;
  txHash: string;
  price: string;
  priceCurrency?: string;  // set on ENSv2 mints, e.g. "USDC"
  transactionFees: string; // formatted ETH string
  records: EnsRecords;
}
```

#### ENSv2 Notes

- Mainnet activations can accept ETH, USDC, or DAI; Sepolia accepts ETH or USDC.
- Whitelist and reservation proofs are fetched automatically. If they can't be fetched, the
  form shows an error with a "Try again" button.
- `SubnameMintFormV2` is also exported: the version 2 form on its own, with the same props
  minus `version` and `noBorder`.

#### Behavior Without Wallet

If no wallet is connected, the form shows a "Connect Wallet" button. Pass `onConnectWallet` to
open your own wallet modal. The availability check and price lookup still work without a wallet.

---

### NameRenewForm

Renews a .eth name: shows the current expiry, prices the extension, and sends the renewal.
Renewals are permissionless, so anyone can extend any name and the owner keeps it.

```tsx
import { NameRenewForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

<NameRenewForm
  name="alice.eth"
  onRenewalSuccess={(data) => console.log("Renewed until", data.newExpiry)}
/>
```

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| name | `string` | `undefined` | "alice" or "alice.eth". Leave empty to let the user type a name |
| isTestnet | `boolean` | `false` | Use Sepolia |
| version | `1 \| 2` | `2` | Leave unset. Renews through the ENSv2 registrar in USDC or DAI |
| referrer | `Address` | Namespace's referrer | Referrer address recorded with the renewal |
| title | `string` | `undefined` | Override card title |
| subtitle | `string` | `undefined` | Override card subtitle |
| className | `string` | `undefined` | Additional CSS class |
| noBorder | `boolean` | `false` | Remove card border |
| onRenewalSuccess | `(data: RenewalSuccessData) => void` | `undefined` | Called after a confirmed renewal |
| onConnectWallet | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called when the connect-wallet button is clicked |
| onCancel | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called on cancel |

---

### SubnameRenewForm

Renews a subname minted under a Namespace ENSv2 activation, at the price the parent's owner
configured. Anyone can renew any subname, and a
whitelisted renewer may renew for free.

```tsx
import { SubnameRenewForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

<SubnameRenewForm
  parentName="myname.eth"
  label="alice"
  onRenewParent={() => openParentRenewal()}
  onRenewalSuccess={(data) => console.log("Renewed until", data.newExpiry)}
/>
```

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| parentName | `string` | **required** | Activated parent, e.g. "myname.eth" |
| label | `string` | `undefined` | Leave empty to let the user type the subname label |
| isTestnet | `boolean` | `false` | Use Sepolia |
| title | `string` | `undefined` | Override card title |
| subtitle | `string` | `undefined` | Override card subtitle |
| className | `string` | `undefined` | Additional CSS class |
| noBorder | `boolean` | `false` | Remove card border |
| onRenewalSuccess | `(data: RenewalSuccessData) => void` | `undefined` | Called after a confirmed renewal |
| onRenewParent | `() => void` | `undefined` | Shows a "Renew <parent>" link when the subname would outlive its parent |
| onConnectWallet | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called when the connect-wallet button is clicked |
| onCancel | `() => void` | `undefined` | Called on cancel |

#### Callback Types

```ts
interface RenewalSuccessData {
  fullName: string;
  txHash: string;
  price: string;
  priceCurrency: string;   // "ETH", "USDC", or "DAI"
  transactionFees: string; // formatted ETH string
  newExpiry: string;
}
```

`NameRenewForm` uses the same callback type.

---

### TransactionProgress and TransactionModal

The progress screen every form uses while a transaction is pending: a rail that fills over
time and holds at 90% until confirmed, optional label/value rows, and an explorer link.
Exported for custom flows. `TransactionModal` wraps it in a modal.

```tsx
import { TransactionProgress, TransactionModal } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

<TransactionProgress
  status="pending"
  hash={txHash}
  details={[{ label: "Name", value: "alice.eth" }, { label: "Action", value: "Renew" }]}
/>

<TransactionModal isOpen={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} status="success" hash={txHash} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| status | `"pending" \| "success" \| "failed"` | **required** | Current state |
| hash | `Hash` | `undefined` | Transaction hash for the explorer link |
| chainId | `number` | `undefined` | Chain for the explorer link |
| isTestnet | `boolean` | `false` | Use Sepolia explorer links |
| title | `React.ReactNode` | per status | Overrides the default title |
| description | `React.ReactNode` | per status | Overrides the default description |
| details | `TransactionDetail[]` | `undefined` | Label/value rows under the rail |
| duration | `number` | `10000` | Milliseconds the rail takes to reach 90% while pending |
| className | `string` | `undefined` | Additional CSS class |
| isOpen | `boolean` | **required** | `TransactionModal` only |
| onClose | `() => void` | **required** | `TransactionModal` only |
| footer | `React.ReactNode` | Close button | `TransactionModal` only. Replaces the default Close button |

```ts
interface TransactionDetail {
  label: React.ReactNode;
  value: React.ReactNode;
}
```

`TransactionPendingScreen` is still exported. Since 3.0 it no longer accepts `message`, and
`hash` is optional.

---

## TypeScript Types (full export list)

```ts
// Records
interface EnsRecords {
  addresses: EnsAddressRecord[];
  texts: EnsTextRecord[];
  contenthash?: EnsContenthashRecord;
}

interface EnsTextRecord {
  key: string;   // see common keys below
  value: string;
}

// Common ENS text record keys:
// "avatar"          — profile image URL or IPFS URI
// "description"     — short bio
// "url"             — website URL
// "email"           — email address
// "com.twitter"     — Twitter/X handle (without @)
// "com.github"      — GitHub username
// "com.discord"     — Discord username
// "com.telegram"    — Telegram handle
// "org.telegram"    — Telegram handle (alternative key)
// "com.reddit"      — Reddit username
// "com.linkedin"    — LinkedIn profile slug
// "header"          — banner/header image URL
// "display"         — preferred display name

interface EnsAddressRecord {
  coinType: number;  // SLIP-44 coin type, e.g. 60 = ETH, 0 = BTC
  value: string;     // address string
}

interface EnsContenthashRecord {
  protocol: ContenthashProtocol;
  value: string;  // CID or equivalent
}

enum ContenthashProtocol {
  Ipfs    = "ipfs",
  Onion   = "onion3",
  Arweave = "arweave",
  Skynet  = "skynet",
  Swarm   = "swarm",
}

// Chain identifiers
type ChainName =
  | "eth"     // Ethereum / EVM (coin type 60)
  | "arb"     // Arbitrum
  | "base"    // Base
  | "bitcoin" // Bitcoin (coin type 0)
  | "matic"   // Polygon
  | "op"      // Optimism
  | "sol"     // Solana
  | "zora"    // Zora
  | "celo";   // Celo

// ENS Listing (used by SubnameMintForm internally)
interface NameListing {
  type: ListingType;
  name: string;
  isVerified: boolean;
  nameNetwork: ListingNetwork;
  l2Metadata?: {
    isBurnable: boolean;
    isExpirable: boolean;
    registryAddress: Address;
    registryNetwork: ListingNetwork;
  };
}

enum ListingType    { L1 = "L1", L2 = "L2" }
enum ListingNetwork {
  Base       = "BASE",
  Optimism   = "OPTIMISM",
  Mainnet    = "MAINNET",
  Sepolia    = "SEPOLIA",
  BaseSepolia = "BASE_SEPOLIA",
}

enum TxProgress { Pending = 0, Success = 1, Failed = 2 }

// ENSv2 payment token (getEnsV2Deployment(isTestnet).paymentTokens)
interface EnsV2PaymentToken {
  symbol: string;   // "ETH", "USDC", or "DAI"
  address: Address;
  decimals: number;
}

type TransactionProgressStatus = "pending" | "success" | "failed";
```

---

## Exported Hooks

```ts
// Low-level ENS resolver utilities (used internally by EnsRecordsForm)
// NOTE: does NOT fetch records — use existingRecords prop on EnsRecordsForm instead
useENSResolver(options: { resolverChainId: number; isTestnet?: boolean; version?: 1 | 2 })
  → {
      getResolverAddress(name: string): Promise<Address>;
      isResolverSupported(resolverAddress: Address): Promise<boolean>;
      setUpdateRecordsTx(update: {
        name: string;
        resolver: Address;
        diff: EnsRecordsDiff;
      }): Promise<Hash>;
    }

// Create an offchain client and memoize it
useOffchainManager(
  name: string,           // parent ENS name, e.g. "myname.eth"
  apiKeyOrToken: string,  // API key from app.namespace.ninja/offchain
  isTestnet?: boolean
) → OffchainClient  // createOffchainClient result, ready to pass to OffchainSubnameForm

// Wait for a transaction receipt with retries and timeout
useWaitTransaction(options: { isTestnet?: boolean; chainId?: number })
  → {
      waitTx(options: {
        hash: Hash;
        retries?: number;       // default: 3
        retryDelay?: number;    // default: 2000ms
        timeout?: number;       // default: 60000ms
        txConfirmations?: number; // default: 1
      }): Promise<TransactionReceipt>;
    }

// Onchain subname mint — looks up listing details from the Namespace API
useMintManager(options: { isTestnet?: boolean })
  → {
      mintClient: MintClient;
      getListingDetails(name: string): Promise<NameListing>;
    }

// Execute an onchain subname mint transaction
useMintSubname(options: { chainId: number })
  → {
      mintSubname(mintTx: MintTransactionResponse): Promise<{ txHash: Hash; price: bigint }>;
      estimateTransactionFees(params: { mintTx: MintTransactionResponse; account: Address }): Promise<EstimatedFees | null>;
    }

// ENS avatar and header image upload via SIWE
useAvatarClient(options: { isTestnet?: boolean; domain?: string })
  → {
      uploadAvatar(params: { ensName: string; file: File; onProgress?: (progress: number) => void }): Promise<UploadResult>;
      uploadHeader(params: { ensName: string; file: File; onProgress?: (progress: number) => void }): Promise<UploadResult>;
      getErrorMessage(err: unknown, imageType?: "avatar" | "header"): string;
    }

// Full ENS registration flow (used internally by EnsNameRegistrationForm)
useRegisterENS(options: { isTestnet?: boolean })
```

Also exported for custom ENSv2 flows: `getEnsV2Deployment`, `getEnsV2RegistrationDeployment`,
`getEnsV2RenewalDeployment`, `isEnsV2NameAvailable`, `quoteEnsV2Mint`, `quoteEnsV2Payment`,
`quoteEnsV2Renewal`, `getEnsV2RenewPrice`, `getEnsV2RenewalTarget`, `detectResolverStyle`,
`sendCallsWithFallback`, `supportsAtomicBatch`, and `estimateEffectiveGasPrice`. These are the
helpers the forms use; prefer the forms unless you are building your own UI.

---

## CSS Custom Properties (complete list)

Import `@thenamespace/ens-components/styles` and then override any variable on `:root`
(or on a scoped selector) to theme the components.

> **v2.0.0 is a visual overhaul** (Namespace Flows design system). The
> library ships a token layer (`styles/tokens.css`) with every token
> `--ns-`-prefixed. The design is light-only: warm off-white ground, a single
> near-black accent, 10px corners, no shadows, DM Sans for text and DM Mono for
> names, amounts, dates and hashes. Fonts load from Google Fonts inside the
> stylesheet itself, so no font setup is needed in the host app. The legacy
> `--ns-color-*`, `--ns-radius-sm/md/lg`, and `--ns-alert-*` variables still
> resolve as aliases, so older overrides keep working, but they are no longer
> the primary levers.

### Layout & Typography

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--ns-font-family` | `"DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif` | Component font stack |
| `--ns-font-mono` | `"DM Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` | Mono font for names, amounts, dates and hashes |
| `--ns-radius` | `10px` | Single radius lever |

The legacy `--ns-radius-sm/md/lg` aliases are now all `0` (corners are
controlled by the single `--ns-radius` token) and `--ns-shadow` is `none` —
the design is shadowless; elevation is a hairline.

### Core Tokens

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `--ns-bg` | `#fbfaf9` | Page ground — set it yourself on the host page |
| `--ns-surface` | `#ffffff` | Card surface |
| `--ns-text` | `#1b1d1e` | Body text |
| `--ns-ink` | `#212121` | The accent — the whole ramp derives from it |
| `--ns-link` | `#0080bc` | Links stay blue, separate from the accent |

### Colors (Legacy Aliases)

| Variable | Resolves to | Description |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| `--ns-color-bg` | `var(--ns-surface)` | Component background |
| `--ns-color-bg-accent` | `var(--ns-surface-3)` | Subtle accent background |
| `--ns-color-bg-accent-hover` | `var(--ns-surface-4)` | Accent hover state |
| `--ns-color-bg-darker` | `var(--ns-surface-4)` | Darker accent |
| `--ns-color-fg` | `var(--ns-text)` | Primary foreground / text |
| `--ns-color-muted` | `var(--ns-text-3)` | Muted / secondary text |
| `--ns-color-primary` | `var(--ns-ink)` | Primary action color (buttons) |
| `--ns-color-primary-contrast` | `#ffffff` | Text on primary color |
| `--ns-color-border` | `var(--ns-border-strong)` | Border color |

### Alert Colors (Legacy Aliases)

| Variable | Resolves to | Purpose |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `--ns-alert-error-bg` | `#fbede6` | Error alert background |
| `--ns-alert-error-border` | `#ebc5b2` | Error alert border |
| `--ns-alert-error-text` | `var(--ns-dot-bad)` | Error alert text |
| `--ns-alert-warning-bg` | `var(--ns-amber-100)` | Warning alert background |
| `--ns-alert-warning-border` | `var(--ns-amber-400)` | Warning alert border |
| `--ns-alert-warning-text` | `var(--ns-amber-700)` | Warning alert text |
| `--ns-alert-info-bg` | `var(--ns-blue-100)` | Info alert background |
| `--ns-alert-info-border` | `var(--ns-blue-300)` | Info alert border |
| `--ns-alert-info-text` | `var(--ns-blue-700)` | Info alert text |
| `--ns-alert-success-bg` | `#eff4f0` | Success alert background |
| `--ns-alert-success-border` | `#c9dace` | Success alert border |
| `--ns-alert-success-text` | `var(--ns-ok)` | Success alert text |

### Dark Theme

`ThemeProvider` still sets `data-theme="dark"` and legacy dark values are kept
so the API keeps working, but the design ships light-only and the dark palette
is unrefreshed — treat dark mode as best-effort, not polished.

---

## Theming Example

```css
/* Minimal brand override */
:root {
  --ns-ink: #7c3aed;            /* re-accent — the whole ramp follows */
  --ns-radius: 4px;             /* sharper corners */
  --ns-font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif;
}
```

---

## Error Handling

### Common Errors

| Scenario | Behaviour |
|----------|-----------|
| Wallet not connected | Components show a "Connect Wallet" button. Pass `onConnectWallet` to open your modal. |
| Wrong chain | Components show a "Switch Chain" prompt. EnsRecordsForm handles this automatically. |
| Name not available | EnsNameRegistrationForm shows an inline error; search stays active. |
| Transaction rejected by user | Alert shown; form resets to pre-submit state. |
| API key invalid / expired | OffchainSubnameForm shows an inline error alert. |
| Subname already taken | Input shows an availability indicator; submit is disabled. |
| RPC error | Alert shown with error message; retry is possible. |
| Not enough of the payment token or ETH for gas | ENSv2 and renewal forms show "Insufficient funds" and block the transaction. |
| Whitelist or reservation proof unavailable | SubnameMintForm shows an error with a "Try again" button. |

### Retry Pattern

All forms reset cleanly after an error — the user can retry without refreshing.

---

## Integration Recipes

### Next.js App Router

```tsx
// components/EnsRegistration.tsx
"use client";
import "@thenamespace/ens-components/styles";
import { EnsNameRegistrationForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

export function EnsRegistration() {
  return (
    <EnsNameRegistrationForm
      onConnectWallet={() => { /* open your RainbowKit / ConnectKit modal */ }}
      onRegistrationSuccess={(r) => console.log(r)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Custom Wallet Connect Integration

```tsx
<EnsNameRegistrationForm
  onConnectWallet={() => openConnectModal()}   // RainbowKit
/>
<SubnameMintForm
  parentName="myname.eth"
  onConnectWallet={() => open()}               // Web3Modal / AppKit
/>
```

### Read & Edit Records

```tsx
import { EnsRecordsForm, EnsRecords } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";
import { useState } from "react";

// Fetch existing records from your own source (e.g. viem getEnsText/getEnsAddress calls,
// or the Namespace API) and pass them into EnsRecordsForm via existingRecords.
function EditRecords({ name }: { name: string }) {
  const [records] = useState<EnsRecords>({ addresses: [], texts: [] });

  return (
    <EnsRecordsForm
      name={name}
      existingRecords={records}
      onRecordsUpdated={(diff) => console.log("Changed records:", diff)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Offchain Subnames with API Key

```tsx
import { createOffchainClient } from "@thenamespace/offchain-manager";
import { OffchainSubnameForm } from "@thenamespace/ens-components";

const client = createOffchainClient({
  domainApiKeys: { "myname.eth": process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_NS_API_KEY! },
  mode: "mainnet",
});

function SubnameForm() {
  return (
    <OffchainSubnameForm
      offchainManager={client}
      name="myname.eth"
      onSubnameCreated={async (data) => {
        console.log("Created:", data.fullSubname);
        // data.addresses, data.texts are also available
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

---

## Utility Classes

The stylesheet exposes a small set of layout utility classes:

| Class | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| `ns-text-center` | `text-align: center` |
| `ns-text-left` | `text-align: left` |
| `ns-text-right` | `text-align: right` |
| `ns-wd-100` | `width: 100%` |
| `ns-card-container` | Styled card wrapper |
| `ns-me-1/2/3` | Margin-end (right in LTR) small/medium/large |
| `ns-ms-1/2/3` | Margin-start (left in LTR) small/medium/large |
| `ns-mt-1/2/3` | Margin-top small/medium/large |
| `ns-mb-1/2/3` | Margin-bottom small/medium/large |
